name: python-combinations
title: Combinations of Small Lists
blurb: combinations of small lists: every subset of items is generated, the count equals two to the power of the length, and distinct subsets are deduplicated; oversized or malformed inputs are named, never combined.
default_description: A combination generator whose count is the power-of-two oracle on every small list, whose entries are all true subsets, and whose oversized or malformed inputs are named, never combined.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: a combination keeps the original order and drops some items
